allow: PowerShell($pid = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess | Select-Object -First 1; if \($pid\) { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force; "Killed PID $pid on port 3000" } else { "Nothing on port 3000" })
